question: Seven boxes F, G, H, I, K, L, and O are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only three boxes are kept below H. Only two boxes are kept between H and O. Only L is kept above G. F is kept at some place below I and at some place above K. Which box is kept at second position from the bottom?
solution:
Seven boxes F, G, H, I, K, L, and O are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• Only three boxes are kept below H.
 
• Only two boxes are kept between H and O.
 
• Only L is kept above G.
 
• F is kept at some place below I and at some place above K
